'''Frostmane Hold''' is the base camp of the [[Frostmane clan|Frostmane]] [[ice troll]]s located in the western edge of the cold mountains of [[Dun Morogh]] south of [[Gnomeregan]]. The hold is comprised of a few buildings and a cave system. Young [[Dwarf|dwarves]] and [[gnome]]s are tasked with exploring the caves and reporting back to [[Kharanos]], in order to determine just how big a threat the trolls were. The area is heavily guarded by troll headhunters and hideskinners.
